commits.summary: Redaction policy 7: Codex encrypted reasoning quoted in text
commits.body: Policy 6 removed Codex's encrypted reasoning under its own key (encrypted_content), but Astra quotes the same ciphertext in command arguments and tool output, where each blob stays a long-token warning that no evidence can vouch for (79 open in the jbmc-java-semantics-gap session alone). Policy 7 adds a text rule for its Fernet form, gAAAAA followed by at least 60 URL-safe base64 characters, with a cheap gate on the prefix. Like policy 6 it is not audited as a leak (UNAUDITED_KINDS), so logs stored before it keep their warnings instead of turning into errors. Test: test_codex.Redaction.test_encrypted_reasoning_in_text, made-up blob in a heredoc, in prose and in echoed JSON; idempotent; no warning left; a pre-policy log is not an error; short or embedded look-alikes are kept. Specification and README updated. The commit landed by accident inside the user's allow-approve commit and was split out of it.

commits.summary: Record four ordinary Commons Lang decimal decisions
commits.body:
Merge the five passed verification jobs on checker source 36542708757f and bind the generated scorecard and example pages to their original classpaths, asserted statements, raw results and JVM evidence. The native checker proves three of the four Commons Lang #1635 statements and refutes precision on the parent. Selector 0 returned Float bits 0x3dcccccd on the parent and a BigDecimal with coefficient 100000001490116121 and scale 18 on the fix. Integrated JBMC reproduced the parent refutation. Its three other candidates held on the original JVM.

Both full-guard native checking and qualified selector calls agree on all four statements. At the original scopes the same build kept 33 proofs and 24 replayed refutations on the 60 frozen caller claims, and 22 proofs and 16 replayed refutations on all 38 historical controls. All three ordinary monitor entries still stop at platform-thread construction. The report links their eight original JVM constructor controls and keeps the four decimal transfers outside that denominator.

Both proof-tier conformance tests passed. Independently reproduced the scorecard under two hash seeds, 283 class bindings on 21 JVM graphs, and eight constructor histories. All 17 example validators and all 30 changed-test groups passed, including 59 Rust binaries and 29 Python suites. Checked 631 local links across 19 pages.
